youtube.title: 🔥 Stop Your AI Agent From Writing Messy Code
youtube.description: Agent Skills is a production-grade engineering framework for AI coding agents with 76,000+ stars on GitHub. It packages 24 engineering workflows that senior developers use into skills your AI agent can follow automatically. Instead of getting prototype-quality code, you get production-ready implementations with proper specs, test-driven development, code reviews, security audits, and performance checks built in. The framework includes 8 slash commands that map to the full development lifecycle: /spec writes a PRD before any code, /plan breaks it into atomic tasks, /build implements with tests, /review enforces quality gates, and /ship handles deployment. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and 70+ other AI agents through a universal CLI install. Each skill is a structured workflow with verification gates and anti-patterns to avoid. You also get pre-configured agent personas like code-reviewer, test-engineer, and security-auditor for specialized reviews. The whole system is MIT licensed and maintained by Addy Osmani. Install with one command: npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills. Stop getting code that breaks in production and start getting engineering that ships with confidence.

linkedin.text:
I used to spend hours cleaning up the code my AI agents wrote.

They'd generate working prototypes, but the code quality was rough. No tests. No documentation. Security holes. Performance problems. The kind of stuff that comes back to haunt you in production.

Then I found Agent Skills on GitHub (76K+ stars) and everything changed.

It's not another AI model. It's a framework that teaches your existing AI agents to code like senior engineers.

You get 24 production-grade workflows: spec-driven development, test-driven implementation, five-axis code review, security auditing, performance optimization, and proper deployment processes.

The magic is in the slash commands. Type /spec and your agent writes a full PRD before touching code. /build breaks it into atomic tasks and implements them one by one with tests. /review enforces quality gates. /ship handles deployment.

Every workflow has verification gates and anti-pattern guards. Your agent can't skip tests. Can't merge without review. Can't deploy without monitoring.

I installed it with one command (npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills) and it works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and 70+ other agents.

Now my AI agents ship production-ready code on the first try.

The difference? I'm building with AI instead of cleaning up after it.

Link to repo in the comments. MIT licensed. Worth every second of your time if you're using AI to code.
